title: FinEvolveBench: A Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents on Low-Repetition Tasks with Implicit Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2606.06960v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Experience-based self-evolution enables language-model agents to improve their behavior by accumulating and updating experience at test time, yet existing evaluations often assume recurring task patterns and explicit success signals. We introduce \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, a benchmark for self-evolving agents on low-repetition tasks with implicit rewards. The benchmark reconstructs a daily financial information stream over 31 Chinese A-share industry indices and aligns 177,324 public news articles with market observations. Researchers can define prediction horizons over this stream; we evaluate predictive market-sentiment factors against delayed market-adjusted returns after 10, 20, and 40 trading days. translated_title: FinEvolveBench：面向低重复任务与隐式奖励的自进化智能体基准
translated_abstract: 基于经验的自我进化使语言模型智能体能够在测试时通过积累和更新经验来改进其行为，但现有评估通常假设任务模式重复且成功信号明确。我们引入了\textsc{FinEvolveBench}，这是一个针对低重复任务且具有隐式奖励的自进化智能体基准。该基准重建了31个中国A股行业指数的每日金融信息流，并将177,324篇公开新闻文章与市场观察对齐。研究人员可以在此信息流上定义预测视野；我们评估预测性市场情绪因子相对于延迟10、20和40个交易日的市场调整后收益的表现。与静态基准独立评分每个预测不同，\textsc{FinEvolveBench}将新决策与早期决策的延迟结果交错进行，测试智能体能否将嘈杂的真实世界反馈转化为可复用的经验。
tldr: 该论文提出了FinEvolveBench基准，通过模拟低重复金融任务和隐式奖励，评估语言模型智能体能否从延迟、嘈杂的真实反馈中提取可复用经验以促进自我进化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FinEvolveBench, a benchmark that simulates low-repetition financial tasks with implicit rewards to evaluate whether language-model agents can extract reusable experience from delayed, noisy real-world feedback for self-evolution.
